job: Two-storey garage in Nudura ICF - Option A - Permitted Development

stages.title: Raft slab
stages.desc: Indicative 200 RC raft with a 600 x 450 thickened edge under the ICF, on DPM and 150 hardcore (engineer to design).

stages.title: Nudura ICF walls
stages.desc: Nudura 6in Standard on Nudura Bond, 4,858 x 5,061 outside - webs on the grid from both corners, NO stack joints; eaves walls 5 courses to the plate, gables raked to the roof with the gable courses flying out over the corners; garage door, pedestrian door(s), window and the raked feature gable opening with its sill closure. Every form as it would be laid.

stages.title: First floor
stages.desc: PS9-type 225 metal-web joists @400 spanning front to rear, top-hung on ledgers off the two ICF gables, 22 P5 deck; FFL 2,656, garage ceiling 2,396. Loft hatch.

stages.title: Roof structure
stages.desc: Loose 47 x 147 C24 rafters @400 on a 100 x 320 GL24h glulam ridge bearing in the gables, 30.5 deg, gable ladders (indicative).

stages.title: Roof membrane + battens
stages.desc: Breathable roofing membrane and 25 x 50 treated battens.

stages.title: Tiles, fascia, soffit + rainwater goods
stages.desc: Concrete interlocking tiles with dry ridge and verge, PVC-u fascia, soffit and 22 x 225 barge boards, half-round gutters and downpipes.

stages.title: Windows + doors
stages.desc: Anthracite (RAL 7016) window, composite door(s), the raked aluminium feature screen with its cill, and the sectional garage door (supplier).

stages.title: Opening tapes
stages.desc: Tremco CPG illbruck ME220 external and ME110 internal window membranes round every opening (garage door excluded).

stages.title: Dryvit 500 render
stages.desc: Dryvit 500 thin-coat render (Tremco CPG), 7.5 build-up, direct to the Nudura EPS, into the reveals to the frames.
